scenarios.description: Forklift clips empty pallet. No injury. Driver didn't see pedestrian who stepped back just in time.
scenarios.explanation: 2,400 lb load. Pedestrian in path 3 seconds prior. Energy + exposure = P-SIF.

scenarios.description: Worker trips over extension cord, catches themselves on railing. No injury.
scenarios.explanation: Low energy event. Trip hazard, not SIF potential. Standard near-miss.

scenarios.description: Breaker thought to be off was actually on. Worker noticed tingling, stopped work.
scenarios.explanation: Contact with energized equipment. Outcome was luck, not control. P-SIF.

scenarios.description: Scaffold plank shifted during use. Worker felt it move, stepped to stable section.
scenarios.explanation: 6+ feet elevation. Plank failure = fall potential. P-SIF.

scenarios.description: Chemical splash on floor during transfer. Cleaned up immediately. No contact.
scenarios.explanation: Contained spill, no exposure pathway. Housekeeping issue, not P-SIF.

scenarios.description: Worker entered confined space before air monitoring complete. Atmosphere was safe.
scenarios.explanation: Safe outcome was luck. No verification = P-SIF. Every time.

scenarios.description: Load shifted during crane lift. Rigger was outside swing radius.
scenarios.explanation: Load control failure. Rigger position was coincidence, not control. P-SIF.

scenarios.description: Worker bumped head on low beam. Minor bruise.
scenarios.explanation: Low energy. Fixed object, low speed. Not P-SIF.
